buddyDebugLogs.device.title: Log lines of this printer
buddyDebugLogs.guide.note: Many metrics are off on the printer until you switch them on in its Metrics List, and that choice is lost when it restarts.
buddyDebugLogs.guide.step1: On the printer, open Settings, then Network, then Metrics & Log.
buddyDebugLogs.guide.step3: Set Syslog Port to {syslog} for the log lines, and Metrics Port to {metrics} for the metrics.
buddyDebugLogs.guide.step4: To send only one of the two, set the other port to 0.
buddyDebugLogs.guide.step5: Switch Enable Metrics on. The log lines need it too.
buddyDebugLogs.guide.title: Set it on the printer
buddyDebugLogs.logs.empty.heading: No log lines yet
buddyDebugLogs.logs.empty.note: Nothing has arrived in this time. An idle printer logs little at info level, so lines come when it heats, prints or reports a problem. If none come then, set up the printer to send its log lines here.
buddyDebugLogs.logs.noMatch.heading: No line matches the filters
buddyDebugLogs.logs.noMatch.note: Widen the time or clear a filter.
buddyDebugLogs.metrics.empty.heading: No metrics yet
buddyDebugLogs.metrics.empty.note: Nothing has arrived in this time. Set up a printer to send its metrics here.
buddyDebugLogs.metrics.noPoints: This metric has no number to draw in this time.
buddyDebugLogs.metrics.truncated: The printers sent more metrics than the list shows. Choose one printer or a shorter time to see the rest.
buddyDebugLogs.purge.confirmAllNote: Every line and every metric point kept here is removed, from every printer. The matched printers stay, and new data keeps arriving. This cannot be undone.
buddyDebugLogs.purge.confirmAllTitle: Delete every log line and metric?
buddyDebugLogs.purge.confirmOlderNote: {hours, plural, one {The lines and metric points from the last hour stay, and everything older is removed, from every printer. This cannot be undone.} other {The lines and metric points from the last # hours stay, and everything older is removed, from every printer. This cannot be undone.}}
buddyDebugLogs.purge.confirmOlderTitle: {hours, plural, one {Delete what is older than # hour?} other {Delete what is older than # hours?}}
buddyDebugLogs.purge.olderThan: {hours, plural, one {Older than # hour} other {Older than # hours}}
buddyDebugLogs.setup.bothOff: With both off, the printer stops sending. Stop sending does the same in one step.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.confirmNote: After you send, the printer shows G-CODE METRICS CONFIG CHANGE on its display. The change is made only when somebody presses Yes there. Every change asks again, also a change of port or switching a stream off.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.confirmTitle: The printer asks you to confirm
buddyDebugLogs.setup.host: Address of this server, as the printer reaches it
buddyDebugLogs.setup.hostHelp: At most 20 characters, so an IP address works best.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.manualFallback: Set it on the printer instead, as the steps below say.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.metricsHelp: Temperatures, fans and other readings, sent to port {port}
buddyDebugLogs.setup.note: The printer sends its log lines and metrics over the local network, unencrypted, to the address below.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.syslogHelp: Info, warnings and errors, sent to port {port}
buddyDebugLogs.setup.title: Send logs and metrics here
buddyDebugLogs.setup.waitNo: No, or no answer, leaves the printer as it was.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.waitStep2: Its display shows G-CODE METRICS CONFIG CHANGE.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.waitStep3: Press Yes. The first lines appear on this page a few seconds later.
buddyDebugLogs.setup.waitStep3Stop: Press Yes. The printer stops sending its log lines and metrics.
buddyDebugLogs.sources.empty.heading: Nothing has arrived yet
buddyDebugLogs.sources.empty.note: A printer appears here once it sends its first log line or metric.
buddyDebugLogs.sources.note: A printer names itself by the MAC address of its Ethernet port. The module matches it to a printer on this server by that address, or by the network address of a printer on Wi-Fi. Match one by hand when it cannot.
buddyDebugLogs.sources.unverified: A printer sends its lines over UDP, which carries no proof of the sender. Anybody on the local network can send lines in the name of a printer, so the address each line came from is shown beside it.
buddyDebugLogs.status.notGrantedNote: This module was installed without its network ports, so printers cannot reach it yet. An administrator allows them on the Extensions page: install Prusa printer logs again and tick Allow it to listen on these ports.
buddyDebugLogs.status.retention: Lines and readings are kept for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, within {size}.
buddyDebugLogs.status.storeProblem: The module cannot write its files: {problem}
buddyDebugLogs.status.title: Receiving
buddyDebugLogs.title: Prusa printer logs
buddyDebugLogs.unreadable.heading: The printer logs cannot be read
buddyDebugLogs.unreadable.note: The module did not answer. Its state on the Extensions page says why.
